from pathlib import Path
import ast
import runpy
import subprocess
expected = {
    'scripts/check_eslint.py': {'invariant': {'eslint-source-rules/1', 'eslint-configuration-rules/1'}, 'data': set()},
    'scripts/check_ruff.py': {'invariant': {'ruff-source-rules/1'}, 'data': set()},
    'scripts/check_shellcheck.py': {'invariant': {'shellcheck-source-rules/1'}, 'data': set()},
    'scripts/check_format.py': {'invariant': {'prettier-source-format/1'}, 'data': {'.gitattributes', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'prettier.config.mjs'}},
    'scripts/check_dependencies.py': {'invariant': {'introduced-npm-vulnerabilities/1'}, 'data': {'foundations/part_map.md', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json'}},
    'scripts/quality_support.py': {'invariant': set(), 'data': {'foundations/part_map.md'}},
    'scripts/inspect_eslint.mjs': {'invariant': set(), 'data': {'eslint.config.mjs', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json'}},
}
pattern = runpy.run_path('.the-way/elements/invariants/format_guard.py')['CITATION']
tracked = set(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z']).decode().split(chr(0)))
for name, wanted in expected.items():
    text = Path(name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    found = {'invariant': set(), 'data': set()}
    for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
        if match:
            kind, value = match.groups()
            found[kind].add(value)
            if kind == 'data':
                assert value in tracked and Path(value).is_file(), (name, number, value)
            print(f'{name}:{number}: {kind}: {value}')
    assert found == wanted, (name, found, wanted)
    if name.endswith('.py'):
        tree = ast.parse(text)
        citations = wanted['invariant']
        if citations:
            main = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'main')
            call = next(node for node in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == 'run_check')
            prior = text.splitlines()[call.lineno - len(citations) - 1:call.lineno - 1]
            assert {pattern.fullmatch(line).group(2) for line in prior} == citations
print('PASS: 6 invariant citations at recorded dispatch; 11 data lines; all targets tracked')
print('PASS: Python bridge literals unchanged; shared/helper data checked explicitly beyond guard file selection')
